name: Tools and Integrations Index
body:
> Index · 2026-10-22

# Summary
Every tool and integration TAG Marketing uses with Claude Code, with access method and standing rules. Credentials are never stored in this vault; notes point to where they live and mark them [redacted].

# Platforms and data
- [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas): SEO platform, OTTO/MetaSync, rank tracking, LLM visibility (connector failing since Sep 29, Chrome fallback).
- [Google Search Console](lib:brain-google-search-console): source of truth for search data and indexing requests.
- [Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile): read-only for Claude; per-client rules.
- [Google Ads MCC](lib:brain-google-ads-mcc): MCC 805-257-4115, read-only, copy-paste recommendations.
- [Google Ads Validation Work](lib:brain-google-ads-validation-work): May 2026 conversion-tracking audit across all three accounts.
- [GoHighLevel](lib:brain-gohighlevel): CRM and forms, read-only tokens per sub-account.
- [WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts): Alphalete call tracking and DNI.
- [Keystone CRM](lib:brain-keystone-crm): internal work CRM, leads, meetings.

# Content and outreach
- [Higgsfield](lib:brain-higgsfield): AI images on Scott's credits.
- [Instantly AI](lib:brain-instantly-ai): cold email (v1 API).

# Hosting and access
- [NameHero Hosting](lib:brain-namehero-hosting): tagmktg.com and Prestige; disk quota blocker.
- [SSH Client Aliases](lib:brain-ssh-client-aliases): summit, alphalete, pipeliners, namehero.

# Claude Code setup
- [Claude Code Agents](lib:brain-claude-code-agents): 7 user-level subagents, skills and plugins.
- [Documentation Screenshots](lib:brain-documentation-screenshots): screenshot evidence system and capture tool.
- Setup guides: [Claude Code Setup Guide](lib:brain-claude-code-setup-guide), [Google Ads MCP Setup SOP](lib:brain-google-ads-mcp-setup-sop), [Instant Indexing Setup](lib:brain-instant-indexing-setup).
